_comment: Hand-checked facts about ONE mailbox, kept out of the code so the pipeline
itself stays generic. Both sections are optional; an empty file is fine.
route_overrides: sender address -> any of action / method / target / note.
Use it when reading the raw message proves the automated scan wrong, e.g.
a sender with no List-Unsubscribe header whose only opt-out is a settings
